items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: Charlie Hardesty, he used to sing with the band. He was the drummer with Alice Freeman in the old days. Of course, in the first few years when I was with the band, too.

ctx.x: Must have been if it got to Canada, because that was clear channeling. It was definitely WWL.

Yeah. And Charlie Hardesty, he used to sing with the band. He was the drummer with Alice Freeman in the old days. Of course, in the first few years when I was with the band, too. And Charlie had a marvelous voice. And he was with the band a long time, and we used to get letters from Canada. It was definitely WWL, because that was a 50,000-watt job that carried way up there.
So, why don't we call it to a halt and grab a little lunch, and we can follow up on this some more if you want to later.
